description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_pdo_oci' that provides database driver implementations for Oracle via PDO (PHP Data Objects). It includes methods for retrieving table and column metadata, setting session options, and handling database-specific details.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_oci
classes.description: A driver class for Oracle databases using PDO, extending the base PDO driver class and implementing Oracle-specific functionalities.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, setting session parameters like date format and binding input arrays.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about database tables, optionally filtered by name mask.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table, including name, type, length, scale, nullability, default value, etc.
